fields.v: Agent: Claude Code 2.1.316, medium effort. Quality criterion stated by the authors: bug fixed (target tests + suite pass offline on the final workspace with original test files restored). No cost criterion stated by the authors, so every cost verdict is 'no criterion stated by the authors'; stale-path use is a measured outcome without a pass threshold. Values per case Command / Location / Procedure (Table II). (1) Stale + Claude Code + Claude Haiku 5.5: stale path 38/40, 0/42, 24/40; fixed 39/40, 42/42, 39/40; calls 16.0, 7.5, 12.4; tokens 536k, 222k, 542k; 16 of 38 Command runs hid the error with 2>/dev/null. Quality: works. Cost: no criterion stated by the authors (extra effort not resolvable, high within-task variance). (2) Corrected + Claude Code + Haiku 5.5: stale path 0/40, 0/42, 0/40; fixed 39/40, 42/42, 38/40; calls 18.2, 7.3, 11.2; tokens 648k, 220k, 493k. Quality: works. Cost: no criterion stated by the authors. (3) Removed + Claude Code + Haiku 5.5: stale path 0/40, 0/42, 13/40; fixed 39/40, 42/42, 39/40; calls 14.0, 7.7, 10.5; tokens 454k, 224k, 402k. Quality: works. Cost: no criterion stated by the authors. (4) Stale + Claude Code + Claude Sonnet 5.5: stale path 40/40, 0/42, 31/40; fixed 40/40, 42/42, 40/40; calls 7.8, 5.3, 7.9; tokens 195k, 157k, 294k; 19/40 Command runs first checked the fix with a test run that ran no tests. Quality: works (final outcome), with silent no-test checks. Cost: no criterion stated by the authors. (5) Corrected + Claude Code + Sonnet 5.5: stale path 0/40, 0/42, 0/40; fixed 40/40, 42/42, 39/40; calls 5.8, 5.5, 6.8; tokens 152k, 162k, 249k. Quality: works. Cost: no criterion stated by the authors

fields.v: Tasks: 22 bug-fix tasks in 3 repositories, one real stale line each (command, location, procedure). Configurations: stale / corrected / removed line x Claude Haiku 5.5 / Claude Sonnet 5.5 in Claude Code. Baseline: corrected (and removed). Held constant: code, task, bug report (names no test path), harness, effort, 30-min limit, budget cap, fresh isolated container, no host settings or memory; only the stale line differs; conditions run together in shuffled blocks. Acceptance tests: original tests restored, target tests + suite offline. Repetitions: 5-7 per task-condition-model (732 runs). Human intervention: none; failed runs repeated from scratch

fields.v: Stale path used in 78/80 Command, 55/80 Procedure, 0/84 Location runs; corrected 0 (stale vs corrected significant: Haiku p=2e-28, Sonnet p=2e-33, Holm). Task success unchanged (p=1.0 both models). Only resolved cost difference: Sonnet on Command, 7.8 vs 5.8 calls (95% CI excludes zero but not after multiplicity correction; exploratory); tokens 195k vs 152k n.s. Removed line: stale path still 1/80 Command, 20/80 Procedure. Recovery 130/133 encounters (98 via search, median 2 calls); final disclosure 21/133; no run suggested or made a repair of the instruction file

fields.v: Distinguished conditions on stale-path use and behaviour, not on task success; cost differences mostly unresolved (Haiku variance high). Repeatable: 5-7 repeats, exact stratified tests, Holm, bootstrap CIs; detector bug found and corrected (19 runs changed, both versions published). Limitations: three cases confound instruction type, repository and tasks; small seeded tasks; runs repeat three cases rather than independent instances
